001package org.clafer.math;
002
003import java.util.ArrayList;
004import java.util.Arrays;
005import java.util.HashMap;
006import java.util.Iterator;
007import java.util.List;
008import java.util.Map;
009import java.util.Map.Entry;
010import java.util.Set;
011import org.clafer.common.Check;
012
013/**
014 * @author jimmy
015 */
016public class LinearFunction implements LinearFunctionable {
017
018    private final Rational[] coefficients;
019    private final Variable[] variables;
020    private final Rational constant;
021    public final Map<Variable, Rational> coefficientMap;
022
023    public LinearFunction(long coefficient, Variable variable) {
024        this(new Rational(coefficient), variable);
025    }
026
027    public LinearFunction(Rational coefficient, Variable variable) {
028        this(coefficient, variable, Rational.Zero);
029    }
030
031    public LinearFunction(long constant) {
032        this(new Rational(constant));
033    }
034
035    public LinearFunction(Rational constant) {
036        this.coefficients = new Rational[0];
037        this.variables = new Variable[0];
038        this.constant = Check.notNull(constant);
039        this.coefficientMap = new HashMap<>(0);
040    }
041
042    public LinearFunction(long coefficient, Variable variable, long constant) {
043        this(new Rational(coefficient), variable, new Rational(constant));
044    }
045
046    public LinearFunction(Rational coefficient, Variable variable, Rational constant) {
047        this.coefficients = new Rational[]{Check.notNull(coefficient)};
048        this.variables = new Variable[]{Check.notNull(variable)};
049        this.constant = Check.notNull(constant);
050        this.coefficientMap = new HashMap<>(1);
051        this.coefficientMap.put(variable, coefficient);
052    }
053
054    public LinearFunction(long[] coefficients, Variable[] variables, long constant) {
055        this(convert(coefficients), variables, new Rational(constant));
056    }
057
058    private static Rational[] convert(long[] is) {
059        Rational[] rs = new Rational[is.length];
060        for (int i = 0; i < rs.length; i++) {
061            rs[i] = new Rational(is[i]);
062        }
063        return rs;
064    }
065
066    public LinearFunction(Rational[] coefficients, Variable[] variables, Rational constant) {
067        Check.notNull(coefficients);
068        Check.noNulls(variables);
069        if (coefficients.length != variables.length) {
070            throw new IllegalArgumentException();
071        }
072        Map<Variable, Rational> map = new HashMap<>(coefficients.length);
073        for (int i = 0; i < coefficients.length; i++) {
074            Rational old = map.put(variables[i], coefficients[i]);
075            if (old != null) {
076                map.put(variables[i], coefficients[i].add(old));
077            }
078        }
079        List<Rational> cs = new ArrayList<>(coefficients.length);
080        List<Variable> vs = new ArrayList<>(variables.length);
081
082        Iterator<Entry<Variable, Rational>> iter = map.entrySet().iterator();
083        while (iter.hasNext()) {
084            Entry<Variable, Rational> entry = iter.next();
085            if (entry.getValue().isZero()) {
086                iter.remove();
087            } else {
088                cs.add(entry.getValue());
089                vs.add(entry.getKey());
090            }
091        }
092
093        this.coefficients = cs.toArray(new Rational[cs.size()]);
094        this.variables = vs.toArray(new Variable[vs.size()]);
095        this.constant = constant;
096        this.coefficientMap = map;
097    }
098
099    public int arity() {
100        return coefficients.length;
101    }
102
103    public Rational getCoefficient(Variable variable) {
104        return coefficientMap.get(variable);
105    }
106
107    public Rational[] getCoefficients() {
108        return coefficients;
109    }
110
111    public Variable[] getVariables() {
112        return variables;
113    }
114
115    public Set<Variable> getVariableSet() {
116        return coefficientMap.keySet();
117    }
118
119    public boolean hasConstant() {
120        return !constant.isZero();
121    }
122
123    public Rational getConstant() {
124        return constant;
125    }
126
127    public Rational getLowBound() {
128        Rational low = constant;
129        for (int i = 0; i < coefficients.length; i++) {
130            low = low.add(coefficients[i].mul(coefficients[i].isPositive()
131                    ? variables[i].getLowBound()
132                    : variables[i].getHighBound()));
133        }
134        return low;
135    }
136
137    public Rational getHighBound() {
138        Rational high = constant;
139        for (int i = 0; i < coefficients.length; i++) {
140            high = high.add(coefficients[i].mul(coefficients[i].isPositive()
141                    ? variables[i].getHighBound()
142                    : variables[i].getLowBound()));
143        }
144        return high;
145    }
146
147    public LinearFunction minus() {
148        Rational[] newCoefficients = new Rational[coefficients.length];
149        for (int i = 0; i < newCoefficients.length; i++) {
150            newCoefficients[i] = coefficients[i].minus();
151        }
152        return new LinearFunction(newCoefficients, variables, constant.minus());
153    }
154
155    public LinearFunction add(LinearFunction addend) {
156        Rational[] newCoefficients = Arrays.copyOf(coefficients, coefficients.length + addend.coefficients.length);
157        System.arraycopy(addend.coefficients, 0, newCoefficients, coefficients.length, addend.coefficients.length);
158        Variable[] newVariables = Arrays.copyOf(variables, variables.length + addend.variables.length);
159        System.arraycopy(addend.variables, 0, newVariables, variables.length, addend.variables.length);
160        Rational newConstant = constant.add(addend.constant);
161        return new LinearFunction(newCoefficients, newVariables, newConstant);
162    }
163
164    public LinearFunction add(long addend) {
165        if (addend == 0) {
166            return this;
167        }
168        return add(new Rational(addend));
169    }
170
171    public LinearFunction add(Rational addend) {
172        if (addend.isZero()) {
173            return this;
174        }
175        return new LinearFunction(coefficients, variables, constant.add(addend));
176    }
177
178    public LinearFunction sub(LinearFunction subtrahend) {
179        Rational[] newCoefficients = Arrays.copyOf(coefficients, coefficients.length + subtrahend.coefficients.length);
180        for (int i = 0; i < subtrahend.coefficients.length; i++) {
181            newCoefficients[i + coefficients.length] = subtrahend.coefficients[i].minus();
182        }
183        Variable[] newVariables = Arrays.copyOf(variables, variables.length + subtrahend.variables.length);
184        System.arraycopy(subtrahend.variables, 0, newVariables, variables.length, subtrahend.variables.length);
185        Rational newConstant = constant.sub(subtrahend.constant);
186        return new LinearFunction(newCoefficients, newVariables, newConstant);
187    }
188
189    public LinearFunction sub(long subtrahend) {
190        if (subtrahend == 0) {
191            return this;
192        }
193        return sub(new Rational(subtrahend));
194    }
195
196    public LinearFunction sub(Rational subtrahend) {
197        if (subtrahend.isZero()) {
198            return this;
199        }
200        return new LinearFunction(coefficients, variables, constant.sub(subtrahend));
201    }
202
203    public LinearFunction mul(long multiplier) {
204        if (multiplier == 1) {
205            return this;
206        }
207        return mul(new Rational(multiplier));
208    }
209
210    public LinearFunction mul(Rational multiplier) {
211        if (multiplier.isOne()) {
212            return this;
213        }
214        Rational[] newCoefficients = new Rational[coefficients.length];
215        for (int i = 0; i < newCoefficients.length; i++) {
216            newCoefficients[i] = coefficients[i].mul(multiplier);
217        }
218        return new LinearFunction(newCoefficients, variables, constant.mul(multiplier));
219    }
220
221    public LinearFunction div(long divisor) {
222        if (divisor == 0) {
223            throw new ArithmeticException("/ by zero");
224        } else if (divisor == 1) {
225            return this;
226        }
227        return div(new Rational(divisor));
228    }
229
230    public LinearFunction div(Rational divisor) {
231        if (divisor.isZero()) {
232            throw new ArithmeticException("/ by zero");
233        } else if (divisor.isOne()) {
234            return this;
235        }
236        Rational[] newCoefficients = new Rational[coefficients.length];
237        for (int i = 0; i < newCoefficients.length; i++) {
238            newCoefficients[i] = coefficients[i].div(divisor);
239        }
240        return new LinearFunction(newCoefficients, variables, constant.div(divisor));
241    }
242
243    public LinearFunction replace(Variable variable, LinearFunction value) {
244        if (!coefficientMap.containsKey(variable)) {
245            return this;
246        }
247        List<Rational> newCoefficients = new ArrayList<>(coefficients.length + value.coefficients.length);
248        List<Variable> newVariables = new ArrayList<>(newCoefficients.size());
249        Rational newConstant = constant;
250        for (int i = 0; i < coefficients.length; i++) {
251            if (variable.equals(variables[i])) {
252                for (int j = 0; j < value.coefficients.length; j++) {
253                    newCoefficients.add(coefficients[i].mul(value.coefficients[j]));
254                    newVariables.add(value.variables[j]);
255                }
256                newConstant = newConstant.add(coefficients[i].mul(value.constant));
257            } else {
258                newCoefficients.add(coefficients[i]);
259                newVariables.add(variables[i]);
260            }
261        }
262        return new LinearFunction(
263                newCoefficients.toArray(new Rational[newCoefficients.size()]),
264                newVariables.toArray(new Variable[newVariables.size()]),
265                newConstant);
266    }
267
268    @Override
269    public LinearFunction toFunction() {
270        return this;
271    }
272
273    @Override
274    public boolean equals(Object obj) {
275        if (obj == this) {
276            return true;
277        }
278        if (obj instanceof LinearFunction) {
279            LinearFunction other = (LinearFunction) obj;
280            return coefficientMap.equals(other.coefficientMap)
281                    && constant.equals(other.constant);
282        }
283        return false;
284    }
285
286    @Override
287    public int hashCode() {
288        return coefficientMap.hashCode() ^ constant.hashCode();
289    }
290
291    @Override
292    public String toString() {
293        if (coefficients.length == 0) {
294            return constant.toString();
295        }
296        StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();
297        for (int i = 0; i < coefficients.length; i++) {
298            if (i > 0) {
299                result.append(" + ");
300            }
301            result.append(coefficients[i].isPositive() ? coefficients[i] : "(" + coefficients[i] + ")");
302            result.append("*");
303            result.append(variables[i]);
304        }
305        if (!constant.isZero()) {
306            result.append(" + ");
307            result.append(constant);
308        }
309        return result.toString();
310    }
311}
